findings.evidenceJa: 固体化した神秘への介入
findings.governingReading: intervention in mysteries that have taken solid form
findings.explanation: A technical material state becomes the malformed and theologically different “physical divine mysteries.”

findings.highlight: a famous occult scholar who pretty much dominated the world
findings.evidenceJa: わりと一世を風靡した神秘学者
findings.governingReading: an occult scholar who, for a time, rather took the age by storm
findings.explanation: An idiom for period popularity becomes literal world domination.

findings.highlight: the proof of adulthood for a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師にとっては一人前の証
findings.governingReading: a sign that a magus is fully fledged
findings.explanation: Professional competence is recast as biological or legal adulthood.

findings.highlight: It’s weak compared to my jewels
findings.evidenceJa: 宝石に比べれば微々たる物
findings.governingReading: The amount stored is tiny compared with her jewels.
findings.explanation: A comparison of stored magical energy becomes a judgment that the dagger itself is weak.

findings.highlight: If you’re going to fight, you have to win
findings.evidenceJa: やるからには死んでも勝ちなさい
findings.governingReading: If you are going to do it, win even if you die.
findings.explanation: Half of Rin’s deliberately paradoxical “win even if you die / do not be dead” encouragement disappears.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka falls asleep right after that
findings.evidenceJa: もうごうごうと、遠慮も容赦もなく寝入ってしまった
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is already sound asleep, roaring away without restraint or mercy.
findings.explanation: Rin’s exaggerated, comic sleeping manner disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: お膳立ては全て整った
findings.governingReading: All the preparations are in place.
findings.explanation: A standard idiom is translated as an unexplained literal board.

findings.evidenceJa: 傷は八割方癒えている
findings.governingReading: The wound is about eighty percent healed.
findings.explanation: A quantitative recovery estimate becomes vague near-completion.
